title: The Core Verbs
label: ch:ta-core-verbs
canDo: I can build a Tamil verb as stem plus tense plus person, swap the tense bead for past or future, tell a strong verb from a weak one by its doubled consonant, and say why தெரியும் carries no person at all.

payoff.summary: Say எனக்குத் தமிழ் தெரியும், name the three slots that built irukkiṟēṉ, pōgiṟēṉ and pārkkiṟēṉ, and explain which slot தெரியும் leaves empty and where its person went instead.
